alive.last_commit_message:
fix(mcp-scan): accept XML-attribute parameter tags from OpenAI-compatible models (#739)

Some OpenAI-compatible models (notably DeepSeek) emit parameters as
<parameter name="x"> instead of the documented <parameter=x> form.
The mcp-scan parser only recognized the documented form, so those calls
parsed with empty arguments and forced the model into an expensive
retry loop (issue reports up to 48 malformed tags per run and 2.65x
slowdown in code mode).

Align the mcp-scan parser with agent-scan, which already accepts both
forms: extend the parameter regex in _parse_tags() and the unclosed
<function=finish> fallback to tolerate the XML-attribute form with
double or single quotes.

Add 7 regression tests covering both forms, mixed forms, multiple
parameters, the unclosed-finish fallback, and mcp_function invocations.

Towards #735

Co-authored-by: aigsec <aigsec@tencent.com>
